Overview

Comilla is a city in Chittagong with a population of 350,000. An ancient city in eastern Bangladesh known for its historic architecture, cottage industries, and the Comilla Board Bazar. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 255 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.0.
